name: Concept A (reconstructed)
description: Reference preset: a dark, gold-accent reconstruction from UX-850-C TOKENS.md role values. NOT verified against the Figma Concept A file (it could not be read); see provenance for which values are documented and which are mapped or invented.

provenance.colors.field: Mapped, not documented: input fill reuses the page colour #121212 as an inset on cards.
provenance.colors.border: Verified: subtle decorative border #2D2D2D (TOKENS.md); too faint for a necessary interactive outline.
provenance.colors.strong_border: Verified colour, mapped role: TOKENS.md names #777777 as the prototype outline that meets 3:1.
provenance.colors.danger: Invented: lighter red for text/borders on dark. The production fill #D9363E is only 4.0:1 on #121212, below the 4.5:1 text target.
provenance.colors.success: Invented: not documented in the research values; copied from Blue Modern.
provenance.colors.danger_fill: Verified: destructive fill #D9363E with white label (TOKENS.md).
provenance.typography: Verified: Segoe UI 10/11/12 pt (small 9 pt mapped from the production type scale).
provenance.spacing: Verified: 4/8/12 steps; gutter 16 is the TOKENS.md proposed composed page gutter; xl 24 is the semantic xl; control minimum 32 is the TOKENS.md proposal.
provenance.borders: Mapped: 2 px outer focus cue proposed in TOKENS.md.
provenance.radius: Mapped, not documented in research: 4/8/12 radii of the production design values, applied as 4/4/8/8.
